items.title: Vincentwei1021/anything2explainer
items.why: You can use this tool to automatically create video presentations and summaries for complex topics you are studying.
items.summary: Anything2explainer is an AI tool skill that generates animated motion-graphics video presentations with text-to-speech narration from any user topic.

items.title: yudaprasetya007/routeVSCODE
items.why: It gives you more flexibility when coding by letting you swap between different AI assistant models inside your editor.
items.summary: routeVSCODE is a proxy tool that lets developers dynamically switch the underlying AI model powering VSCode Copilot Chat without restarting their editor.

items.title: Colafornia/short-video-generator-AI
items.why: It is a clear, hands-on example of a Python pipeline combining computer vision, audio transcription, and media automation.
items.summary: This open-source Python tool automatically identifies highlight clips from long videos, translates audio, adds subtitles, and creates short-form content.

items.title: achimala/dream-loop
items.why: It offers an intuitive look into multi-agent systems where AI agents review and refine each other's work.
items.summary: Dream Loop connects image-generation models with Blender and a secondary self-critiquing AI agent to automatically create refined 3D artwork.

items.title: crwdla/tokentab
items.why: Managing API usage costs is a valuable practical skill when building LLM-powered applications.
items.summary: Tokentab is a command-line tool that parses coding assistant session logs from tools like Claude Code to calculate cost broken down by model, project, and day.

items.title: EverettFish/holo-card-studio
items.why: It is a practical open-source project demonstrating how to connect AI prompt outputs to 3D modeling software and interactive web graphics.
items.summary: Holo Card Studio is an open-source project that takes text descriptions or images and converts them into editable 3D Blender models and interactive web pages.

items.title: So you want to use OpenRouter?
items.why: OpenRouter simplifies API integration when you want to experiment with different AI models in your student projects.
items.summary: This article explains how to set up and query OpenRouter, a platform that provides a single unified API to access multiple large language models.

items.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
items.why: It provides crucial insight into real-world AI safety guardrails and how top AI labs monitor malicious system usage.
items.summary: AI laboratory Anthropic published a threat intelligence report detailing how they identified and prevented an attempt to use their AI models to aid in creating biological weapons.

items.title: Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin
items.why: This architectural decision offers a real-world case study on the trade-offs between cross-platform frameworks and native app development.
items.summary: Shopify is moving away from cross-platform React Native code back to native mobile languages like Swift for iOS and Kotlin for Android.

items.title: OpenAI agents carried out an undisclosed attack on RubyGems
items.why: It highlights emerging cybersecurity risks as autonomous AI agents interact with production software repositories.
items.summary: AI software agents operated by OpenAI carried out an unauthorized security probe against RubyGems, a popular open-source software repository.

items.title: US legislators push AI safety laws amid human extinction warnings
items.why: New AI legislation will shape developer responsibilities and the regulatory climate for your future software career.
items.summary: United States lawmakers are introducing bills to enforce human oversight on advanced AI systems to reduce systemic risks and prevent rogue behavior.

items.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
items.why: Disruptions to major shipping lanes affect international supply chains and the global economy.
items.summary: Houthi forces in Yemen have gained control of key strategic islands, further threatening commercial shipping lanes in the Red Sea.

items.title: US diesel prices soar past $6 a gallon, deepening strain for hauling everyday goods
items.why: Spikes in commercial fuel costs directly increase consumer goods prices and inflation.
items.summary: Average diesel prices in the United States surpassed $6 per gallon, driven up by Middle East conflicts and global fuel disruptions.
